lines: Sankta Lucia, ljusklara hägring,
SAHNK-tah loo-SEE-ah, YOOS-klah-rah HEHG-ring
sprid i vår vinternatt glans av din fägring.
spreed ee vohr VIN-ter-naht glahns ahv deen FEHG-ring
Drömmar av vingesus under oss sia,
DRÖM-mar ahv VING-eh-soos UN-der oss SEE-ah
tänd dina vita ljus, Sankta Lucia.
tend DEE-nah VEE-tah yoos, SAHNK-tah loo-SEE-ah
pronunciation.note: The last two lines are sung twice.
tips: sounds like “y”, the l is silent: ljus = yoos, ljusklara = YOOS-klah-rah
the vowel in “bird”, with rounded lips: drömmar
“oo” with the lips pushed forward: Lucia, ljus, vingesus
always “ee”: sprid, i, din, vita, sia

lines: Jul, jul, strålande jul,
yool, yool, STROH-lahn-deh yool,
glans över vita skogar,
glahns ÖÖ-ver VEE-tah SKOO-gar,
himmelens kronor med gnistrande ljus,
HIM-meh-lens KROO-nor mehd GNIST-rahn-deh yoos,
glimmande bågar i alla Guds hus,
GLIM-mahn-deh BOH-gar ee AH-lah gudds hoos,
psalm, som är sjungen från tid till tid,
sahlm, som air HWUNG-en frohn teed till teed,
eviga längtan till ljus och frid!
EH-vi-gah LENG-tahn till yoos ock freed!
Jul, jul, strålande jul: glans över vita skogar!
yool, yool, STROH-lahn-deh yool: glahns ÖÖ-ver VEE-tah SKOO-gar!
tips: sound like “y”, the l is silent: jul = yool, ljus = yoos
“oo” in skogar and kronor: SKOO-gar, KROO-nor
a soft, breathy sound between “sh” and “hw”: sjungen
say the g too: gnistrande = g-NIST-rahn-deh
the final e is sung: STROH-lahn-deh, GLIM-mahn-deh
